sources.entry: TG Pro - Temperature monitoring, fan control & hardware diagnostics to help keep your Mac cool and healthy.

summary.name: TG Pro
summary.one_liner: TG Pro is a macOS menu bar utility for monitoring Mac temperatures, fan speeds and hardware health, with automatic and manual fan control.
use_cases: monitor Mac CPU and GPU temperatures
automatically raise fan speed when temperatures rise
check SSD and drive health via SMART
log temperatures and fan speeds to CSV
get alerts for overheating or unexpected shutdowns
deploy fan control across multiple Macs
summary.what_it_does: TG Pro shows temperature readings for CPU (including individual Apple Silicon cores), GPU, drives via SMART, battery, and other sensors such as memory, power and Thunderbolt, with current and highest-recorded values. Auto Boost rules tie a sensor temperature threshold to a fan speed so fans adjust automatically. Users can also set fan speeds manually or use Max for immediate cooling, where the Mac model supports fan control. It can send macOS notifications, email alerts with system information, and CSV logs of temperatures, fan speeds and diagnostics. Command-line options exist for remote or silent deployment.
notable: Auto Boost rules link any sensor threshold to a fan speed
Notarized by Apple with Hardened Runtime; no tracking or analytics code
Homebrew cask install and remote/silent deployment options
Hackintosh support via generic sensor detection in settings
caveats: Fan speed control requires a Mac with fans; fanless Macs can only monitor temperatures
Manual and Max options depend on Mac model and settings
Supports macOS 10.14 to macOS 27; older models may need a previous TG Pro release
One-time purchase; personal license covers up to three Macs, business license covers one Mac
